t: The Rolling Pin and the Paint: AI-Powered Information Architecture
s: This article argues for the continued importance of traditional Information Architecture (IA) principles like hierarchy and taxonomy in the age of AI. It proposes using AI as an 'intelligent rolling pin' to analyze content and craft effective navigation structures, a methodology termed 'AI IA'.
sub: AI as 'intelligent rolling pin' for content analysis and IA creation
Re-emphasis on hierarchy/taxonomy as 'trellis' for AI crawlers and quality signal for search engines
Critique of 'Generative SEO' and the shift from static organization to dynamic content blending
Hardware obsolescence vs. adaptable software frameworks (e.g., Framework Laptop)
AI IA: Mimetic polyalloy rolling pin for imposing order on chaotic data
